phase: specified before any CompPhish model scores
source: Hannousse V3 creator-supplied parsed-DOM snapshot subset; labels cross-checked to dataset_B CSV
target: CompPhish V4; DOI 10.17632/fmbs4kp9wz.4; collection September 2024 to August 2025
representation: normalized_url_v3 44 numeric features plus passive_html_v1 28 shared static DOM aggregations. This new 72-feature contract does not reuse or rename either creator's engineered features; it is not direct transfer of the old 68-input model.
adapters: Source DOM objects are read as inert primitive data with pickletools, no pickle.load, imports, constructors, REDUCE or downloaded code. Target text snapshots use lxml HTMLParser with no network. Shared aggregation meanings are tested; original parser/capture differences remain a limitation.
eligibility: All sources: HTTP(S) hostname, no internal whitespace/angle brackets/double quotes in URL; valid published binary label; finite extracted features; require nonempty DOM elements; maximum 25MB target HTML text and 250000 nodes; audit all exclusions by class.
duplicates: Remove canonical-URL conflicts, exact semantic-DOM fingerprint conflicts and within-source duplicates before splitting. Exclude all target registered domains appearing in the complete retained source CSV, and all target content fingerprints appearing in any source snapshot. Record remaining shared-feed/campaign uncertainty.
source_split: GroupShuffleSplit seed20261007,70% fitting/30% calibration by registered domain; both classes required. No source test tuning.
target_split: StratifiedGroupKFold5 seed20261007:folds0-2 sealed final test,fold3 target fitting,fold4 target calibration. These are roles, not fivefold CV. Fixed-source models never fit/calibrate on target labels; mixed-source models use only target folds3/4.
sampling: At most12rows/source/class/domain, shuffle seed71007; equal source/class weight then equal domain contribution within each source/class stratum
selection: For each feature branch/fitting regime independently: maximize mean phishing recall at the 5% empirical calibration FPR budget across represented calibration sources and seeds; tie by AP then listed family order. Frozen cutoffs obey each source's observed normal-row budget and exclude score ties. No final target outcomes used.
primary_evaluation: Each frozen branch/regime selection on untouched target domains; report all seeds and candidates, TP/TN/FP/FN,FPR,recall,precision,F1,AP,AUC,domain-macro rates. Never pick the primary winner from test outcomes.
uncertainty: 1000 paired whole-domain bootstrap replicates seed20261007 for seed42 URL/page and source/mixed contrasts; conditional on the trained models, not universal superiority.
target_interpretation: Prespecified study targets; a miss is retained and explained, not removed or retuned on the sealed test.
explanations: Verify accepted selected mixed-source page model TreeSHAP/linear signed contributions against actual output. Use probability for forest, raw log odds for boosting; no causal or user-trust claims.
time_scope: Collection periods do not give per-record observation or verification time. No claim of natural-time drift is made. No live destinations are visited.
post_test_policy: Any later revision based on this final test is exploratory; another new data source is required for fresh blind confirmation. Earlier Hannousse/Wangchuk tests remain already-inspected evidence.
